Pattern: Home-country share of starts differs by league and club
Meaning for the model: Possible pre-match feature: % of home-country starters in today's XI (known at lineup time). Not in the current model.

Pattern: Home-country share vs points per match
Meaning for the model: Spearman rho = -0.16 overall; check within leagues before using it as a feature.

Pattern: Players move a lot between clubs and leagues
Meaning for the model: The model uses each match's real XI and each player's latest value, so moves are reflected automatically.

Pattern: Money flows towards the richest leagues
Meaning for the model: Explains why market values differ by league, which is why strength is ranked within league.

Pattern: Goals and home advantage change over seasons (COVID dip)
Meaning for the model: Chronological train / validation / test split; R script 04 tests time dependence.

Pattern: Stronger XI wins most decided matches
Meaning for the model: This is the main signal of the model (xi_strength_diff).

Pattern: Cards differ by league, season and position
Meaning for the model: Possible pre-match feature: a team's cards in its PREVIOUS matches (discipline, suspensions). Never the same match.

Pattern: Goals and cards rise towards the end of each half
Meaning for the model: Goal-timing distribution can drive a minute-by-minute match simulation in the web app.

Pattern: Red card strongly changes the result
Meaning for the model: Happens during the match: leakage if used for prediction.
